name: FIRST SHIP LEASE TRUST
summary: FIRST SHIP LEASE TRUST is a Singapore-based real estate investment trust (REIT) that invests in a diversified portfolio of income-producing properties, predominantly consisting of oceangoing container ships. The trust leases these ships to various container shipping companies, generating rental income for its investors. First Ship Lease Trust operates with the goal of providing stable and sustainable returns to its unitholders through its ship leasing business.
